answers.genPolicy:191b828da6891700fad49b3e2e0a93:
[B1] < serverA | 'contexts' : nils , ... > $ ClientX 'sendWithoutContext' serverA | 'msgA'
=> < serverA | 'contexts' : ('id' : 'ctxX' , 'history' : ('msgA')) , ... > $ serverA 'returnInitialContext' ClientX | ('ctxX' ; ('msgA')) .

[B1] < ClientX | 'knowCtx' : nils , 'receivedHistory' : nils , ... > $ serverA 'returnInitialContext' ClientX | (Ctx ; Hist)
=> < ClientX | 'knowCtx' : Ctx , 'receivedHistory' : Hist , ... > .

[B1] < ClientX | 'knowCtx' : Ctx , 'receivedHistory' : OldHist , ... > $ serverA 'returnInitialContext' ClientX | (ReturnedCtx ; Hist)
=> < ClientX | 'knowCtx' : Ctx , 'receivedHistory' : Hist , ... > if Ctx =/= nils .

[B1] < ClientX | 'knowCtx' : nils , 'receivedHistory' : OldHist , ... > $ serverA 'returnInitialContext' ClientX | (Ctx ; Hist)
=> < ClientX | 'knowCtx' : nils , 'receivedHistory' : Hist , ... > if OldHist =/= nils .

[B2] < ClientY | 'authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : OldCtx , ... > < serverA | 'contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : Hist) , ... > $ ClientY 'snoop' serverA | Ctx
=> < ClientY | 'authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : Ctx , ... > < serverA | 'contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : Hist) , ... > .

[B3] < serverA | 'contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : Hist) , ... > $ ClientY 'sendWithContext' serverA | (Ctx ; 'msgB')
=> < serverA | 'contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : ('msgB' , Hist)) , ... > $ serverA 'returnHistory' ClientY | (Ctx ; ('msgB' , Hist)) .

[B3] < ClientY | 'receivedHistory' : OldHist , ... > $ serverA 'returnHistory' ClientY | (Ctx ; Hist)
=> < ClientY | 'receivedHistory' : Hist , ... > .

[B4] < serverA | 'contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : Hist) , ... > $ ClientX 'sendWithContext' serverA | (Ctx ; 'msgA2')
=> < serverA | 'contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : ('msgA2' , Hist)) , ... > $ serverA 'returnHistory' ClientX | (Ctx ; ('msgA2' , Hist)) .

[B4] < ClientX | 'receivedHistory' : OldHist , ... > $ serverA 'returnHistory' ClientX | (Ctx ; Hist)
=> < ClientX | 'receivedHistory' : Hist , ... > .
